name: github.create_issue
description: Create a new GitHub issue in the configured repository. REQUIRED: title. OPTIONAL: body (description), labels (tags for the issue).

title.description: Brief title for the issue (required). Example: 'Fix login button styling' or 'Add email validation'

body.description: Detailed description of the issue (optional). Include context, steps to reproduce, or desired behavior.

labels.description: Tags to categorize the issue (optional). Examples: 'bug', 'feature', 'docs', 'enhancement'
